question: Was constrained DAS's apparent complement success memorization of its small discovery task, and do frozen noise, KL, or direct multi-output regularization improve truly fresh cue/construction transfer?

nearest_results: Unregularized scalar cDAS beat DIM on its scalar target but lost badly on centered full-vocabulary effects.
Noise sigma 0.05 alone did not repair full-vocabulary transfer; KL weight 1 moved the solution close to DIM but did not beat it.

Direct centered-effect regularization selected lambda 0.3 on held-out A1 and narrowly beat DIM on sealed A2 full-vocabulary error, 0.233426 versus 0.238513, while narrowly losing the scalar comparison.
prior_art_search.novelty: No result evaluates all frozen axes on a second cue lexicon and a new syntactic frame. This test performs no fitting or hyperparameter selection and therefore directly separates regularization from task memorization.

frozen_design.authority: A new deterministic 128-row bank uses In-the-future/In-the-past cues, shifted reporters and objects, and bare versus report-states frames. It is sealed before model access and has no target-text overlap with the Tomorrow/Earlier or Later/Previously banks.
frozen_design.unit: The independently localized closure-valid native component block11 H3 only.

axes.dim: Recomputed from the original 16 even A1 discovery rows.
axes.noise: Frozen tangent-noise sigma 0.05 scalar cDAS axis.
axes.aligned: Frozen direct centered full-vocabulary lambda-0.3 axis selected before this authority existed.

frozen_design.evaluation: Evaluate every A1 and A2 row, without capability-based selection, on scalar answer/foil and centered full-vocabulary exact-H3 match plus complement inertness. Native base and donor correctness is reported as a validity/capability diagnostic.
frozen_design.selection: None. No fresh result changes an axis, weight, rank, threshold, or panel.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_closure_and_: Authority hashes hold; each panel has at least 75% correct native base and donor runs; full-rank identity closure is <=1e-4; all values are finite; execution is within 36 forwards and 1120 example-evaluations.
predictions.pred_b_regularization_reduces_unregulari: At least one of noise, KL, or aligned has strictly lower full-vocabulary joint error than unregularized on both fresh panels.
predictions.pred_c_aligned_beats_dim_out_of_task: The frozen aligned axis has strictly lower centered full-vocabulary joint error than DIM on both fresh panels.
predictions.pred_d_aligned_preserves_behavioral_usef: The aligned scalar joint error is at most 1.25 times DIM on both panels and is lower than unregularized on both panels.
predictions.pred_e_regularization_ranking_is_constru: The same regularized method has the lowest full-vocabulary joint error among noise, KL, and aligned on A1 and A2.

decision: screen if all predictions pass; regularization_helpful_dim_best if A,B,D pass but C fails; regularization_unstable if A,B pass but D or E fails; overfit_not_repaired if A passes but B fails; invalid if A fails. This is identification evidence, not adoption.
